entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding, you're through to VeloFit. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi... uh, yes. I have this VeloBand tracker, and I think I need to send it back? I'm just a bit overwhelmed by the process.
I can certainly look into that for you. To start, could you provide me with your order number?
Oh, sure. Let me find it... here it is. It's VF-98221-5B.

Thank you. Let me pull that up... I see the VeloBand GPS Tracker delivered on December 15th, which was 23 days ago. To understand the best way to help, can I ask what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

Oh no, it works fine, I think. I just... I honestly **changed my mind**. It was a bit of an **impulse buy** around the holidays, and I just **don't use it** at all. The website was confusing. Can't you just help me?
I understand completely. So it's not a defect, you'd just prefer not to keep the device. Let me just take a moment to review our official return policy for you.
Alright, I've just consulted our knowledge base. It looks like you're well within the return period.
Oh, really? I was so worried I was too late. That's a huge relief.

Yes, our policy states that items can be returned within 90 days of delivery. Since you're only on day 23, we can definitely process a full refund for you. I am emailing you a prepaid shipping label as we speak.
Wow, okay. That was so much easier than I thought it would be. Thank you so much, Alex.
You're very welcome. Once we receive the item, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can help you with?
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
